description: P3 coupling. The overlord consumer pins the overlord's own trunk-safety sentence — `Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch; never push without first confirming the current branch is not trunk.` — the claim-carrying clause of THIS rule at the consumer site. Its first clause deliberately coincides with this fixture's source pattern in safety-rails.md: that is the same rule correctly witnessed at two sites, not a foreign-pattern paste — do not 'fix' the coincidence by widening one side. Honest guarantee: deleting the trunk-commit prohibition from either file turns the suite red; a rewrite-around or meaning inversion that keeps these bytes intact is outside what a presence pin can see.

source.pattern: Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch

consumers.pattern: Never commit directly to the resolved trunk branch; never push without first confirming the current branch is not trunk.
